findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] app/apis/auth/services/register_user_service.py: register_user is declared as a plain def, not async def, so FastAPI runs it in its threadpool and the synchronous work it performs (SQLAlchemy session writes and the password hash inside create_user) never executes on the event loop. No blocking call - no sync driver, requests, time.sleep, or crypto routine - is invoked from an async def handler in this file. Using a def endpoint for a synchronous dependency is the recommended offload mechanism, equivalent to run_in_threadpool | verdict=pass confidence=high
